articles.title: GEG Collaborates with DSAL and Local Organizations to Support the Professional Growth of Local Team Members
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group is working with DSAL, local associations and higher education institutions on professional training and skills certification for team members. Since the beginning of 2026, around 1,500 local team members have completed over 16,000 training hours across Food & Beverage, Facilities Management and Security.

articles.title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai
articles.summary: On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a kick-off event for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards, themed “Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins.” Wynn announced the 2027 calendar, with judging week in Beijing from August 21–25 and the annual awards ceremony in Macao on October 29.

articles.title: GEG Donates MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong to Support Its Annual Fundraising Campaign for the 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: GEG marked its 23rd consecutive year of support for Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign with a donation of MOP700,000. Since 2004, GEG has donated more than MOP11 million to Tung Sin Tong.

articles.title: Sands China Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Fundraising Campaign for 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.rawDate: Nov.11 Sands China Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Fundraising Campaign for 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Sands China donated MOP700,000 to the Macau Tung Sin Tong Charitable Society at a cheque presentation at The Venetian Macao on November 11, marking 23 consecutive years of support for the annual fundraising campaign.

articles.title: MGM Learning Festival 2026 Opens to Advance Government–Academia–Industry Collaboration in Talent Development
articles.summary: The MGM Learning Festival 2026, jointly organized with DSEDJ and DSAL, opened at MGM COTAI on November 5 under the theme “Empowering Talent for High-Quality Development.” MGM signed a memorandum of understanding with the Macau Institute of Management and Zhejiang University and launched three talent-development initiatives covering academic advancement, professional skills and Chinese cultural literacy.

articles.title: Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.summary: Sands China donated funds and gifts valued at over MOP400,000 to Caritas Macau for the 2026 Charity Run and the 57th Charity Bazaar, its 23rd consecutive year of support. 150 Sands Cares Ambassadors took part in both events.

articles.title: Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.summary: Sands China partnered with the Macau Band Directors Association to present the association’s 30th anniversary concert at The Parisian Theatre, bringing together over 550 musicians from Macao and France for audiences of more than 1,500.

articles.title: MGM Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Charity Event for the 19th Consecutive Year
articles.summary: MGM donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign, its 19th consecutive year of support, bringing cumulative donations to MOP10 million.

articles.title: SJM Successfully Hosts the 2026 World Alba White Truffle Charity Auction
articles.summary: SJM hosted the 2026 World Alba White Truffle Charity Auction at Don Alfonso 1890 at Grand Lisboa Palace, with an 850g white truffle selling for €100,000. Proceeds will benefit the Charity Fund from the Readers of Macao Daily News and Tung Sin Tong’s 2026 annual fundraising campaign.

articles.title: Mr. Francis Lui Named Asia’s Most Influential Industry Leader for the 10th Time; Advancing Innovation and Industry Development
articles.summary: Mr. Francis Lui, Chairman of Galaxy Entertainment Group, has been named the most influential industry leader in the “2026 Asian Gaming Power 50” for the 10th time. GEG’s Chief Operating Officer – Macau, Kevin Kelley, was also named on the list.

articles.title: Chef Tam's Seasons at Wynn Palace Once Again Ranks Among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026 51-100 List
articles.summary: Chef Tam's Seasons, the signature Cantonese restaurant at Wynn Palace, once again ranks among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026, taking the No.73 spot on the 51-100 list and remaining the only restaurant in Macao on the ranking. It also ranked No.7 in The 50 Best Restaurants Asia 2026, announced in March — the third consecutive year it has been the only Macao restaurant on that list.

articles.title: The “1st Greater Bay Area Health and Longevity Summit & Awards Ceremony” concludes successfully in Macao
articles.summary: The 1st Greater Bay Area Health and Longevity Summit & Awards Ceremony, sponsored by Melco, concluded at Studio City on November 5 with more than 360 guests and 25 speakers from 10 regions. The event closed with an awards ceremony honoring 17 GBA organizations and individuals for contributions to Big Health, medical innovation and the integration of healthcare and tourism.

articles.title: GEG Recognized as Top Winner at HR Excellence Awards 2026; Honored with the Grand Winner Award for its Excellence in Talent Development
articles.summary: GEG received eight accolades at the HR Excellence Awards 2026, organized by Human Resources Online, including the Grand Winner Award, and was the only integrated tourism and leisure enterprise in Macau among this year’s recipients. The haul included five Gold awards for employee development, leadership development, internship recruitment, employee volunteerism and ESG strategy.
